svg.aria-label: Matrix transpose: read rows into a shared-memory tile and write columns out, so both sides are coalesced; one extra column of padding avoids bank conflicts
svg.text: a warp reads one contiguous row: coalesced
one extra column: a column's elements land in different banks
a column read out is exactly a row of the output: coalesced
A naive transpose strides either the read or the write (a whole row per thread), losing most of the bandwidth; a tile keeps the stride in shared memory
